biotools.summary: PEPbench is an open-source Python package designed for benchmarking algorithms used to extract the pre-ejection period (PEP) from electrocardiography (ECG) and impedance cardiography (ICG) signals. It provides a standardized framework and annotated datasets for evaluating these algorithms, facilitating reproducible research in psychophysiology.
